description: Defines the CookieDeletionInfo struct and nested TimeRange class for specifying cookie deletion parameters, including time ranges, cookie attributes, and deletion controls within the net namespace.

classes.name: CookieDeletionInfo
classes.description: Struct used to specify which cookies to delete, including time range, session control, host, name, URL, domain/IP filters, and partitioning.

classes.name: TimeRange
classes.description: Nested class within CookieDeletionInfo that defines a time interval with inclusive start and exclusive end, used to filter cookies by creation or expiration time.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a given time falls within the TimeRange.

methods.name: SetStart
methods.description: Sets the start time of the TimeRange.

methods.name: SetEnd
methods.description: Sets the end time of the TimeRange.
